title.zh: 环上的蜂窝为什么合不拢
title.en: Why the honeycomb would not close

summary.zh: 奇数列的晶格首尾错半格，接缝上出现一圈只连两根杆的原子。眼睛先发现的，几何验算确认的。
summary.en: With an odd column count the lattice ends half a cell out of step, leaving a ring of atoms with two bonds instead of three. Spotted by eye, confirmed by counting.

zh: 少数原子看起来像两颗叠在一起，是渲染问题还是几何问题？
什么样的列数能让蜂窝在环面上真正闭合？
en: A few atoms look like two spheres stacked on each other. Is that rendering or geometry?
Which column counts let a honeycomb actually close on a torus?

verdict: 环面上完整的蜂窝必须满足 E = 1.5V。接缝处少了 14 根杆，这个比值就掉到 1.489——现在它是场景自检的一条断言。
